report: During the night patrol at the West Gate, I found a vehicle that was reported stolen earlier today. The driver-side window is smashed, and the ignition appears to have been tampered with. The vehicle is parked close to the restricted facility entrance. I have secured the area, but I do not know whether the suspect entered the facility. This incident occurred at the Bengaluru Operations Center, Karnataka, India.

responses.reply: I have received your report regarding the stolen vehicle found at the West Gate of the Bengaluru Operations Center with a smashed window and tampered ignition. You noted that the area is secured, but it is unknown if the suspect entered the restricted facility. To ensure your safety and coordinate the appropriate response, could you clarify if you are currently in any immediate danger or if you have observed any suspects nearby?
